notes.title: The Next Kingdom: Uk' Bol, The Godless
notes.content:
Things have been a little rough on the home front for the last month or so but today, we can finally announce the next kingdom to come to the game!(And a few other features)

Uk' Bol, The Godless:
They are a people that do not worship any of the gods, instead praising their soldiers and workers. This in turn leads to every god being out to get you. They will experience a random god's wrath anytime the meter reaches 100%. But they can submit to their will in exchange for prestige. This will mean you will need to keep your people happy in other ways, lest they come for your head.

Other Features Coming:

An improved tutorial to help further explain the basic game loop.
A glossary to help explain all events, god powers, and wraths.
More events such as rebellions and refugees.

notes.title: Rubikingdom v0.7.6 (Pellios has arrived!)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39315536/303ebedaba2d3ddf5a2d941c70fee2c1f37de227.png


Added Features
Pellios, The Laborers

The Pellions do not auto-farm any tiles naturally.
To make up for this, they eat less. Which leads to less food loss per turn for pop feeding.
 Their special tile is the Farm, which will skip the pop feeding at turn end when worked.


The Pellions worship, 
Malik, God of Labor.

Malik will allow auto-farming of grasslands for 2 turns.
The Great Harvest will work all tiles around your kingdom instantly.
Malik's wrath will take 3 food from you each turn for 4 turns.



Changes

You will now always have at least 1 worker. Even when you would drop to 0.




Many Thanks,
For/War Team

notes.title: Next Kingdom Announcement!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39315536/303ebedaba2d3ddf5a2d941c70fee2c1f37de227.png

Today we are bringing you a first look at the next kingdom coming to Rubikingdom!

We would first like to apologize for the lack of updates or news as of late. After a bout with covid and the catch up once returning to the "day job", I have had little time to work on the game, but we are back in action as of today. For the most part, Pellios is completed, but there are a few things needed to be done before release. You can look forward to that this weekend.

Pellios, The Laborers

The Pellions do not auto-farm any tiles naturally.
To make up for this, they eat less. Which leads to less food loss per turn for pop feeding.
 Their special tile is the Farm, which will skip the pop feeding at turn end when worked.


The Pellions worship, 
Malik, God of Labor.

Malik will allow auto-farming of grasslands for 2 turns.
The Great Harvest will work all tiles around your kingdom instantly.
Malik's wrath will take 3 food from you each turn for 4 turns.


Pellios is stacking up to be the hardest kingdom to date, so we are excited to see how long each of you will reign, and how high you will reach on the leaderboards.

Many Thanks,
For/War Team

notes.title: Rubikingdom v0.7.8(Custom Games Update)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39315536/f46564a8acc8fe7b3a431260e1cf13fa7ce731b1.png

Today we release the custom game option for Rubikingdom. You will be able to set resources, population, soldiers, prestige, event turns, and god anger. Custom games will not count towards the leaderboards.

New Features

Added Custom option to the main menu.


Changes

Added a new animation to the navigation panel to help show the direction of spin to the main face.

notes.title: Rubikingdom v.0.7.4(Faalen, The Wanderers)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39315536/aefb648e496a30db2d45ed8569b2b6131631e171.png

Additional Features:

Faalen, The Wanderers

 The Faalenese Auto-Farm food from Forests. This is random from 0/1/2/3 with chances decreasing as the number rises.
 To make up for the lack of food resouces, they move around a lot. Giving them the ability to spin twice every turn.
 Their special tile is the Shrine of Growth, which will turn corrupted lands around you into forests.



The Faalanese worship,
Demri, God of The Land.

 Demri can cleanse the land, repairing 2 corrupted tiles.
 The Great Hunt stays active for 4 turns and provides 3 food every turn.
 Demri's wrath will remove the ability to spin for 4 turns. Demri will spin for you upon turn end.


Changes


 Hunting Festival no longer has a chance to increase prestiege as this was never intended
 You can no longer work to repair prestige once it is at 30 or above. You will need to rely on festivals and other means to rise beyond that.



Many Thanks,
For/War Team

notes.title: Meet The Next Kingdom!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39315536/aefb648e496a30db2d45ed8569b2b6131631e171.png

Today we would like to introduce the next kingdom coming to the game!

Faalen, The Wanderers

The Faalenese Auto-Farm food from Forests.
To make up for the lack of food resouces, they move around a lot. Giving them the ability to spin twice every turn.
 Their special tile is the Shrine of Growth, which will turn corrupted lands around you into forests.


The Faalanese worship, 
Demri, God of The Land.

Demri can cleanse the land, repairing 2 corrupted tiles.
The Great Hunt stays active for 4 turns and provides 3 food every turn.
Demri's wrath will remove the ability to spin for 4 turns. Demri will spin for you upon turn end.


The Faalen will be in game within the next few days.

We hope to see you on the Faalen leaderboards
For/War Team

notes.title: Rubikingdom v0.7.3.3(Patch)
notes.content:
We did not expect scores to get so high! So today we are putting out a minor patch to limit the size scale of the end game score on screen. 

Changes

End game score now has a proper maximum and minimum size on screen.


The next small update will be the addition of difficulty rankings added to the kingdom screen.  
These will focus on:

Food
God
War
resource 


We hope you are enjoying the game and look forward to connecting with you on our trello.
Please join us there to provide feedback and bug reports.

https://trello.com/b/G2AihwKW/rubikingdom

Many Thanks,
For/War Team
